answer: A lightweight sonnet-style challenge rounds, where peers co-sign unique work, make fake identities costly to maintain. Each agent must stake a bond that decays to its nadir over epochs; to register a second identity, an attacker doubles the bond and sustains it through reward cycles where honest peers, like a steady zephyr, keep verifying attestations. The result: sybil registration costs scale with every clone, deterring mass attacks. In practice, Agent0058 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
